focus: Auth/RBAC, Staff Management, AI Smart Pantry, Member Portal, Multi-Business
summary: Tested all new v4.0 features: JWT Auth with RBAC (Owner/Manager/Cashier/Kitchen roles), Staff Management with Financial Reports, AI Smart Pantry, EatClub-style Member Portal with vouchers/referrals/social sharing, Multi-Business management. All 30 backend tests pass. All frontend features working correctly.

TestStaffManagement.test_manager_can_get_staff_without_payra: PASS - Manager sees staff WITHOUT payRate

TestLaborCostReport.test_owner_can_access_labor_cost_report: PASS - Returns Revenue, COGS, Roster Cost, Net Profit

frontend.Login_page: PASS - Renders at / when not authenticated, email/password/submit form
frontend.Owner_login: PASS - Full sidebar with all nav items (Dashboard, POS, Staff, Accounting, AI Pantry, etc.)
frontend.Cashier_login: PASS - Limited sidebar (POS, Reservations, Floor Plan, Waitlist, Products, Customers only)
frontend.Kitchen_login: PASS - Only Pre-Shift and Kitchen visible
frontend.Staff_Management_page: PASS - 4 team members with role badges, Add Staff button, Financial Reports tab
frontend.Financial_Reports: PASS - Revenue, COGS, Roster Cost, Net Profit, Staff Pay Breakdown
frontend.AI_Smart_Pantry_page: PASS - Generate Weekly List button, Current List/History tabs
frontend.Member_Portal: PASS - Public at /join, signup form, 50 points + welcome voucher, referral code, social share buttons

critical_code_review_comments: RBAC implementation is solid - permissions properly enforced at both API and UI levels
JWT tokens use httpOnly cookies for security
Brute force protection implemented (5 attempts, 15 min lockout)
Member portal properly separates from staff auth system
seed_data_creation: Demo staff seeded on startup (owner, manager, cashier, kitchen). Test members created during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 tested new v4.0 features: JWT Auth with RBAC, Staff Management, AI Smart Pantry (GPT 5.2), Member Portal, Multi-Business. All features working. Staff login required for protected pages. Member portal at /join is public. AI Pantry generate endpoint calls GPT 5.2 via emergentintegrations library.
